svg.title: Talk Before You Enforce
svg.desc: Sketch from slightly above: five mannequins stand around a round table on a single pedestal, three behind it and one at each side, and the table top is hatched. Small arcs of speech come from them toward the middle of the table. In the front right corner, a fence panel lies flat on the ground, unused. The people are the group sharing a system, from the pattern's context, now with problems to deal with. The round table is the solution: a place for the group to talk, such as a chat channel or a regular check-in, and it is the focus. The speech arcs are a problem being raised there first, with everyone, rather than decided by an admin alone. The fence panel is technical enforcement such as quotas, permissions, and bans: set aside, not built, and still there if the group chooses it later. The metaphor: a round table with no head, where the group's own judgment comes before any fence.
